The Office of Mayor Joseph M. Polisena, Jr.
Mayor Joseph M. Polisena, Jr. is a dedicated and forward-thinking leader shaping the future of the Town of Johnston. A graduate of Rhode Island College in 2012, he went on to earn his law degree from Roger Williams School of Law in 2015 and began his legal career as a Public Defender for the State of Rhode Island in 2016.
From 2019 to 2023, Mayor Polisena Jr. served as Vice President of the Johnston Town Council, where he was recognized for his leadership in advancing major initiatives, including the Amazon Fulfillment Center project that solidified Johnston's reputation as a hub for private investment.
Elected Mayor in January 2023, Polisena Jr. has championed stable taxes, robust private-sector development, strong public safety, and efficient town services. He quickly introduced a fresh leadership style - rolling back the ban on food trucks to boost small business opportunities, hiring a grant writer who has secured millions of dollars for Johnston and its residents, and making key leadership changes with the appointments of new police and fire chiefs. He also ensured that Johnston’s police officers, once among the lowest paid in Rhode Island, now earn competitive salaries that reflect their service and commitment.
In October 2023, Polisena Jr. notably accepted the relocation of the Christopher Columbus statue from Providence, preventing its destruction and establishing it as both a cultural landmark and symbol of heritage in Johnston War Memorial Park.
Committed to continuous learning, Mayor Polisena Jr. has furthered his education while serving the public, earning a Master of Business Administration from Providence College in 2021 and a Master of Public Administration from Syracuse University in 2025.

function.name: fetch_url_content
function.description: This tool belongs to the Web Search API category. It provides functions to search the web and browse search results. Tool description: This function retrieves content from the provided URL and processes it based on the selected mode. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.

mode.description: The mode to process the fetched content. `raw` returns the raw HTML content; `markdown` converts raw HTML content to Markdown format for better readability, using html2text; `truncate` extracts and cleans text by removing scripts, styles, and extraneous whitespace.
